meta.name: PoC 1 (A7): DPIR + MARL recovery on 1 x 4-sector + 6 x 2-sector N367 and 8 IP-50
meta.event: t0: the devices that die lose power at their switched PDU outlets: the hub (its AC PoE injector), CORE's two IP-50 radios, SRV-E2E and SRV-DPIR. The hub's six paths and the W1-CORE and CORE-E1 hops go down with them; no attenuator moves at t0. W1-W2 and E1-E2 unchanged. Bridges ATT-07..09 (links between surviving nodes) step down from their off-beam setting when MARL engages their sites.

assumed: one 3.6 m x 0.8 m bench table to the right of the rack, top at 750 mm (estimate)

steps.title: Assemble the rack
steps.text: Build the StarTech 4POSTRACK42 (42U), set the rail-to-rail depth to 900 mm, level it and bond it to earth. Stack from U1 upwards: power at the bottom.

steps.title: Mount the PDUs
steps.text: Fit the switched PDUs at the bottom (2U each), outlets facing the rear (to confirm). Do not plug them into the wall yet.

steps.title: Mount the DC drawers
steps.text: Rectifier shelves and distribution panels above the PDUs: -48 V for the IP-50 radios (if any), then 48 V for the node adaptors. Breakers and fuses OFF.

steps.title: Adaptor shelf
steps.text: Fit the 1U shelf and place each DC/PoE adaptor under the node it feeds (spares at the right, unwired) and the AC PoE injector of each node that is switched off at t0.

steps.title: Programmable attenuators
steps.text: Fit one 1U vented shelf per 2U attenuator slot, then stand two attenuator boxes on each, ATT-01 top-left, numbers increasing left to right and downwards. SMA IN/OUT and the dial face the front; LAN and power at the back.

steps.title: Splitter / coupler tray
steps.text: Fit the 1U tray directly under the Spider boxes; place one body under each module tile it serves, all the same way round.

steps.title: Spider boxes
steps.text: Mount the four 1U Spider boxes in order SB1 (top) to SB4. Note the module map on each front panel (sheet 2 of the blueprint).

steps.title: Servers and traffic hosts
steps.text: Fit the rails and slide in the rack servers (sizes in the rack schedule), network ports at the back.

steps.title: Switches, cable manager, shelves
steps.text: Cable manager under the switches; SW-OOB and SW-DATA; GNSS splitter at the top; agent PCs on their shelf.

steps.title: Blanking panels
steps.text: Blank every empty U.

steps.title: Bench table
steps.text: Place the bench table to the right of the rack and set out the equipment: the operator station (bench controller PC, monitor, keyboard) nearest the rack, the IP-50 chains around MWATT, the analyser at the far end, the strip along the back edge.

steps.title: Cable: AC mains
steps.text: 38 cables; tag both ends with the ID before routing.

steps.title: Cable: DC power
steps.text: 16 cables; tag both ends with the ID before routing.

steps.title: Cable: PoE to the nodes
steps.text: 7 cables; tag both ends with the ID before routing.

steps.title: Cable: Data to SW-DATA
steps.text: 28 cables; tag both ends with the ID before routing.

steps.title: Cable: Management to SW-OOB
steps.text: 29 cables; tag both ends with the ID before routing.

steps.title: Cable: GNSS
steps.text: 8 cables; tag both ends with the ID before routing.

steps.title: Cable: Operator station
steps.text: 2 cables; tag both ends with the ID before routing.

steps.title: IF link HUB-W1 (ATT-01)
steps.text: Tile i of HUB.W to ATT-01 CH i IN, CH i OUT to tile i of W1.E; torque 8 in-lb.

steps.title: IF link HUB-W2 (ATT-02)
steps.text: Tile i of HUB.W to ATT-02 CH i IN, CH i OUT to tile i of W2.E; torque 8 in-lb.

steps.title: IF link HUB-E1 (ATT-03)
steps.text: Tile i of HUB.E to ATT-03 CH i IN, CH i OUT to tile i of E1.W; torque 8 in-lb.

steps.title: IF link HUB-E2 (ATT-04)
steps.text: Tile i of HUB.E to ATT-04 CH i IN, CH i OUT to tile i of E2.W; torque 8 in-lb.

steps.title: IF link HUB-S (ATT-05)
steps.text: Tile i of HUB.S to ATT-05 CH i IN, CH i OUT to tile i of S.N; torque 8 in-lb.

steps.title: IF link HUB-N (ATT-06)
steps.text: Tile i of HUB.N to ATT-06 CH i IN, CH i OUT to tile i of N.S; torque 8 in-lb.

steps.title: IF link E2-W2 (ATT-07)
steps.text: Tile i of E2.N to ATT-07 CH i IN, CH i OUT to tile i of W2.S; torque 8 in-lb.

steps.title: IF link E1-N (ATT-08)
steps.text: Tile i of E1.N to ATT-08 CH i IN, CH i OUT to tile i of N.W; torque 8 in-lb.

steps.title: IF link W1-S (ATT-09)
steps.text: Tile i of W1.S to ATT-09 CH i IN, CH i OUT to tile i of S.E; torque 8 in-lb.

steps.title: IP-50 conducted chains
steps.text: Radio -> waveguide transition -> 30 dB pad -> 1 m SMA -> MWATT channel -> 1 m SMA -> pad -> transition -> radio. Set every MWATT channel before powering the radios.

steps.title: Checks and power-up
steps.text: Run the install checks (this guide's last section), then power up: PDUs, DC drawers (breakers one by one), switches, nodes, radios.

checks.name: Every port carries at most one cable
Every cable reaches along its route
IF cables not grossly over-length (slack loops)
checks.detail: 0 IF cables use under 35 % of their length (dress the slack in the cable manager)

checks.name: Every rack device fits the rail depth
No two devices share a rack unit
Spider SMA tile ports
checks.detail: 71 of 71 used; unused ones get ANNE-50+ loads
